datasheet_identity.title: BZX584C2V4 THRU BZX584C43 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: The supplied datasheet covers the BZX584C2V4 through BZX584C43 family; BZX584C10-specific tabulated values were selected from the BZX584C10 row.
The zener curve is the BZX584C10 family trace manually digitized from Fig. 1; its plotted current is in mA and its y-axis is logarithmic.

The datasheet includes family plots for capacitance and dynamic impedance but no single numeric capacitance value or capacitance curve uniquely identified for BZX584C10 was transcribed into the schema.
Reverse recovery time is not published.
